title: System of record
decision: Owned backend stores lead PII consent geocoding clusters reports and exports

title: DNS authority target
decision: Use Cloudflare as authoritative DNS after preflight
rationale: Cloudflare API and DNS tooling are better suited for automation

title: Initial Shopify integration
decision: Use Shopify landing page CTA to leads.bentondrones.com
rationale: Simpler safer launch than immediate App Proxy

title: App Proxy validation requirement
decision: Require HMAC/signature validation before production App Proxy trust

title: Dolt-backed local tracking
decision: Use repo-local portable Dolt plus CSV source/export tables
rationale: Winget installer was cancelled so portable Dolt was installed under ignored .tools

title: Geocoder provider chain
decision: Use US Census Bureau Geocoder as primary with Nominatim fallback and a DB-backed response cache
rationale: Both are free keyless public services; Census has best US street-address coverage; Nominatim covers fallback cases; caching avoids repeat network calls and respects provider usage policies

title: Email send mechanism
decision: Use Python stdlib smtplib over Google Workspace SMTP with app password and a DB-backed send queue; defer SMS
rationale: Zero new dependencies or paid services; reuses existing Workspace mailbox; DB queue guarantees no signup is lost or blocked by email failure; SMS adds cost and consent complexity not needed at launch

title: Rate limiter design
decision: Use token-bucket-in-DB with atomic updates for cross-process shared limits; no Redis
rationale: Existing database provides atomicity needed for multi-process correctness; avoids adding Redis infrastructure for a single-host deployment; survives restarts unlike in-memory limiting

title: JIRA replay strategy
decision: Use on-read sweep plus optional daemon replay with exponential backoff dead-letter and idempotency keys
rationale: On-read sweep guarantees progress without a running worker; daemon adds timeliness in production; backoff plus dead-letter prevents poison-message loops; idempotency makes at-least-once delivery safe

title: Cloudflare Pages admin dashboard
decision: Host admin UI as static assets on Cloudflare Pages at admin.bentondrones.com gated by Cloudflare Access with Render API at leads.bentondrones.com validating Access JWT server-side; disable onrender subdomain; remove password login; noindex
rationale: ADR-001 Option B chosen for instant admin shell + MFA/SSO via Access + defense-in-depth JWT verification + free tier; Option D documented as fallback if CORS complexity is unwanted
